title: FT-IR Spectroscopy Analysis of HF-Treated Mineral Soils
author: Spence, Wallace, et al.

steps.title: Air‑dry and sieve bulk soil
steps.instruction: Air‑dry composite soil samples, disaggregate them, remove all debris (e.g., plant material and stones), and sieve the material through a stainless‑steel sieve with a 2 mm aperture.

substeps.instruction: Remove debris such as plant material and stones
Sieve through a stainless‑steel sieve with a 2 mm aperture

steps.title: Collect <2 mm fraction
steps.instruction: Collect the <2 mm soil fraction for molecular‑level FT‑IR analysis.

steps.title: Grind and sieve fine fraction
steps.instruction: Take a subsample of the <2 mm fraction, grind it in an agate mortar, and sieve the ground material through a 150 μm stainless‑steel sieve.

substeps.instruction: Take a subsample of the <2 mm fraction
Grind the subsample in an agate mortar
Sieve the ground material through a 150 μm stainless‑steel sieve

steps.title: Store size fractions
steps.instruction: Place both the <2 mm fraction and the <150 μm fraction into acid‑washed screw‑cap polyethylene jars and keep them until analysis.
